mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (session_id, sender_id, sender_type, content, msg_type, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{senderId}, #{senderType}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
